data.title: How to read a mineral water label
data.excerpt: What TDS, pH and mineral composition on the label mean — and how to choose the right water.
data.body:
What is TDS?

Total dissolved solids (TDS) is the total amount of minerals dissolved in water, expressed in mg/L.

pH

pH shows how acidic or alkaline water is. Drinking water is usually close to neutral.

Minerals

Calcium, magnesium, sodium and bicarbonate are the key minerals that shape taste and character.
